mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_agent_revision (id, agent_id, version, model_id, system_prompt, prompt_checksum, runtime_config_json, tool_policy_json, skill_policy_json, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{agentId}, #{version}, #{modelId}, #{systemPrompt}, #{promptChecksum}, #{runtimeConfigJson}, #{toolPolicyJson}, #{skillPolicyJson}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.agent_id, r.version, r.model_id, r.system_prompt, r.prompt_checksum, r.runtime_config_json, r.tool_policy_json, r.skill_policy_json, r.created_by, r.created_at FROM ds_agent_revision r JOIN ds_agent_definition d ON d.id = r.agent_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.id, r.agent_id, r.version, r.model_id, r.system_prompt, r.prompt_checksum, r.runtime_config_json, r.tool_policy_json, r.skill_policy_json, r.created_by, r.created_at FROM ds_agent_revision r JOIN ds_agent_definition d ON d.id = r.agent_id WHERE r.agent_id = #{agentId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.version
